# iMuslimLife / Muslim Companion

> Prayer times, the Quran, Hijri dates, qibla, duas, Names of Allah and masjid and halal-food places for the whole world, free and without ads, from iMuslimLife (imuslimlife.com): the makers of the Salat-e-Mustaqeem app, Mihrab TV and the Muslim Companion Alexa skill. AI agents can use our public, read-only MCP server instead of guessing prayer times.

Prayer times depend on location, date, calculation method and Asr madhab. Ask the user for their city (or coordinates) and, if they follow one, their method and madhab (standard Asr, or Hanafi for a later Asr). All times are local to the place. Always tell users to follow their own masjid's timetable for congregation.

## Prayer times

- Pages: `/prayer-times/<cc>/<city>/` (today, next prayer, the month) and `/prayer-times/<cc>/<city>/<month>/` for each month (`january` to `december`). `<cc>` is the lower-case ISO country code, `<city>` the lower-case slug. Country lists are `/prayer-times/<cc>/` and `/prayer-times/countries/`. Find a real city slug in the sitemap, [sitemap-cities.xml](https://imuslimlife.com/sitemap-cities.xml).
- Languages: English (no prefix) and Arabic, Urdu, French, Indonesian, Turkish and Malay under `/ar/`, `/ur/`, `/fr/`, `/id/`, `/tr/`, `/ms/` (for example `/ar/prayer-times/sa/riyadh/`). Not every city exists in every language; check the sitemap.
- Methods: 23 are offered (ISNA, Muslim World League, Umm al-Qura, Karachi, Egyptian, Moonsighting Committee, Gulf, Kuwait, Qatar, Dubai, Singapore, JAKIM, Kemenag, Diyanet, UOIF France and others). Each country has a default; the visitor can change it on the page.
- Defaults: ISNA in the United States and Canada, Muslim World League for most of Europe, Africa and the rest, Karachi with Hanafi Asr in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh and Afghanistan, Umm al-Qura in Saudi Arabia and Yemen, Diyanet in Turkey, Kemenag in Indonesia, JAKIM in Malaysia.
- Method details: [How we calculate prayer times](https://imuslimlife.com/about/methodology/).
- Examples: https://imuslimlife.com/prayer-times/ https://imuslimlife.com/prayer-times/countries/ https://imuslimlife.com/prayer-times/us/new-york/ https://imuslimlife.com/prayer-times/us/new-york/january/ https://imuslimlife.com/prayer-times/ca/toronto/ https://imuslimlife.com/ar/prayer-times/sa/riyadh/ https://imuslimlife.com/ur/prayer-times/pk/karachi/ https://imuslimlife.com/fr/prayer-times/sn/dakar/ https://imuslimlife.com/id/prayer-times/id/jakarta/ https://imuslimlife.com/tr/prayer-times/tr/ankara/ https://imuslimlife.com/ar/prayer-times/sa/riyadh/january/ https://imuslimlife.com/about/methodology/ https://imuslimlife.com/sitemap-cities.xml

## Quran

- Pages: `/quran/<n>-<slug>/` for each of the 114 surahs, for example `/quran/1-al-faatiha/`; `/quran/surahs/` lists them all. Other languages use the prefix (`/ur/quran/1-al-faatiha/`). The sitemap [sitemap-quran.xml](https://imuslimlife.com/sitemap-quran.xml) has every slug.
- Each page has the Arabic text with tajweed colours, the Saheeh International English translation and audio recited by Maher Al-Muaiqly.
- Examples: https://imuslimlife.com/quran/ https://imuslimlife.com/quran/surahs/ https://imuslimlife.com/quran/1-al-faatiha/ https://imuslimlife.com/quran/2-al-baqara/ https://imuslimlife.com/ur/quran/1-al-faatiha/ https://imuslimlife.com/sitemap-quran.xml

## Places (masjids, halal food, services)

- Pages: `/places/` (hub), `/places/<cc>/` (country), `/places/<cc>/<city>/` (city) and `/places/<cc>/<city>/<slug>/` (one place, for example a masjid or a halal restaurant). `/places/world/` is the Atlas. Listed places are in [sitemap-places-index.xml](https://imuslimlife.com/sitemap-places-index.xml).
- Freshness: details such as parking, a women's prayer space or how meat is slaughtered carry the date they were last confirmed; when nobody confirms a fact for a long time the page marks it possibly out of date, and later hides it. There are no star ratings or written reviews, only vouches from people who were there. Jamaat times come from the masjid itself (Masjid Connect) or from worshippers, and the page says which.
- Data notes: [About the data](https://imuslimlife.com/places/about/data/).
- Examples: https://imuslimlife.com/places/ https://imuslimlife.com/places/world/ https://imuslimlife.com/places/us/ https://imuslimlife.com/places/us/orlando/ https://imuslimlife.com/places/us/orlando/majid-al-ihsaan-04fc/ https://imuslimlife.com/places/about/data/ https://imuslimlife.com/sitemap-places-index.xml

## Hijri calendar and dates

- Today's Hijri date: `/hijri-date/`. Calendar by year and month: `/hijri-calendar/<year>/` and `/hijri-calendar/<year>/<month-slug>/` (for example `/hijri-calendar/1448/jumada-al-thani/`). Also [Islamic calendar](https://imuslimlife.com/islamic-calendar/), [Gregorian-Hijri calendar](https://imuslimlife.com/calendar/) and [Ramadan](https://imuslimlife.com/ramadan/).
- Dates are calculated (Umm al-Qura); moon-sighting communities may differ by a day.
- Examples: https://imuslimlife.com/hijri-date/ https://imuslimlife.com/hijri-calendar/1448/ https://imuslimlife.com/hijri-calendar/1448/jumada-al-thani/ https://imuslimlife.com/islamic-calendar/ https://imuslimlife.com/calendar/ https://imuslimlife.com/ramadan/

## Qibla

- Pages: `/qibla/` (finder), `/qibla/<cc>/` and `/qibla/<cc>/<city>/` (compass bearing and distance to the Kaaba for that city).
- Examples: https://imuslimlife.com/qibla/ https://imuslimlife.com/qibla/us/ https://imuslimlife.com/qibla/us/new-york/

## Duas and Names of Allah

- Duas: `/duas/` and `/duas/<slug>/` (Arabic, transliteration, translation), for example `/duas/dua-for-leaving-and-entering-the-home/`.
- The 99 Names of Allah: `/names-of-allah/` and `/names-of-allah/<n>-<slug>/`, for example `/names-of-allah/1-ar-rahmaan/`.
- Examples: https://imuslimlife.com/duas/ https://imuslimlife.com/duas/dua-for-leaving-and-entering-the-home/ https://imuslimlife.com/names-of-allah/ https://imuslimlife.com/names-of-allah/1-ar-rahmaan/

## Apps and products

- [Salat-e-Mustaqeem app](https://imuslimlife.com/mobile-app/): free, no ads. Prayer times, Athan, Quran with audio, qibla, duas, masjid and halal-food places. iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Android.
- [Mihrab](https://imuslimlife.com/mihrab/): a free masjid TV display showing prayer and iqamah times.
- [Tasmīʿ](https://imuslimlife.com/tasmi/): recite the Quran in the app and the page follows you word by word, marking skipped words for review; on-device, never recorded, works offline, free. It checks words, not tajweed.
- [Niyyah](https://imuslimlife.com/niyyah/): turn an intention into a small, steady step.
- [Muslim Companion for Alexa](https://imuslimlife.com/alexa-skill/): the Athan, adhkar, Quran and masjid reminders on Amazon Echo; guides under `/alexa-athan/`.
- Examples: https://imuslimlife.com/mobile-app/ https://imuslimlife.com/mihrab/ https://imuslimlife.com/tasmi/ https://imuslimlife.com/niyyah/ https://imuslimlife.com/alexa-skill/ https://imuslimlife.com/alexa-athan/setup/

## MCP server and API (for AI agents)

- Endpoint: https://alexa.imuslimlife.com/v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no sign-in, public data only).
- Tools: `find_location` (place name to coordinates and time zone), `get_prayer_times` (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha and the Hijri date for a day), `get_next_prayer`, `get_hijri_date`, `get_qibla_direction`, `list_calculation_methods`.
- Typical flow: `find_location("Toronto")` then `get_prayer_times(latitude, longitude, date?, method?, madhab?)`.
- Rate limits: 60 requests per minute and 600 per hour per client. Cache a day's times rather than asking repeatedly.
- Guides: [AI Agents setup](https://imuslimlife.com/ai-agents/) (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot / VS Code, your own code); [free prayer times API](https://imuslimlife.com/api/).
- Examples: https://imuslimlife.com/ai-agents/ https://imuslimlife.com/api/
